about: Codes, promotions and automated texts: the same answers from the extension (test/filters/run.mjs on extension/library.js) and the Android app (android/app/src/test/.../ClutterTest.kt on Clutter.kt). A sender is a name (the contact's, or the address when there's none), a number, whether it's a group, and whether it's a text chat. All senders, numbers and texts are invented.
